claim: Announced in episode 815: a brand new website, a brand new members area, and three free courses available now, one on erection quality, one on stamina and one on freedom from porn

The three free courses are "podcast reforged courses": from all 815 episodes, the ones that matter most around one outcome, curated, divided into modules and sequenced in a way that makes sense, so you can go through them step by step
Coming very soon, as of episode 815: other podcast reforged courses, a brand new community to connect with other men in this tribe, new coaching options, and a new iOS and Android app
The need behind the podcast reforged courses, one maybe you have felt: guys who find the show, or maybe come back to it after a while, have a particular outcome they really want to work on
On a lot of the topics that matter most, like erection quality, stamina and freedom from porn, 40 or 50 or 60 different episodes of the show mention it in one way or another
Scrolling back through all 800 episodes of the show is not even realistic, and searching on Spotify just gives a big list where you don't know what's what
